ivory shirt with a closed collar
high-buttoned deep teal waistcoat covering the chest

accepted.note: The owner accepted this run's frames on 2026-11-05. A pose whose generated prompt still equals the prompt baked in that run counts as drawn.

clap.open.why: The pose table raises the forearms over a skeleton with arms down: all 4 candidates drew four arms (LESSONS_LEARNED A5). The words now match the skeleton.
clap.open.description: standing square and upright, both arms held out to the sides and angled down, elbows soft, both open hands at hip height away from the body, palms forward, chin up. Nothing in front of her chest or apron

groove.pass_l2.why: A forearm at hip height disagreed with the skeleton's outstretched arm, and 'her right hand' drew the shaker in the wrong hand. The prop is named by picture side.
groove.pass_l2.description: hip popped out to her right over the straight right leg, right hip high, right shoulder dipped, left knee bent with the left foot resting on its toe, right arm stretched out to the left side of the picture at chest height, left forearm bent across the belly, head tilted toward her left
groove.pass_l2.props: She holds a small silver cocktail shaker in the hand of the outstretched arm, on the left side of the picture; her other hand is empty.
